what: The lighting rigs (L1 B4; docs/design/LOOK_BIBLE.md rules 1-3, 5, 7-9, 11). Every scene under the cel model is lit by the rig its preset names (AtmospherePreset.Rig; logic/Look/Rigs.cs). A rig changes only what it names; 'base' is the rig it starts from. Play rigs: the key in world degrees (Atmosphere.Set: azimuth round from +x toward +z, elevation up). Camera rigs (the close-up, the Look): the key camera-relative, degrees round from the lens toward its right and up. Colors are sRGB hex; ink is linear rgb (B5's --ink-rig). --cel off lights by the presets as they were (no rig).

night_play.from: LB_light NIGHT and targets 09/10: a moon-blue key from the road's far end (Low Ford's corridor, so what stands on the road throws its shadow toward the camera), the sky's indigo fill coloring the shade band (rule 2, h 220-290), her ember the one warm pool in a cold dark (rules 1, 3: key 2.0+, pool 0.35+, Lp50 0.15-0.30, cold 60%+); the moon through the canopy in big leaf shapes (rule 9, 09 and 10). Start: LowFordNight (G1 r3). Tuned (B4r2, the lookdev stage's play night): the moon bluer and up (#80b6f2 1.7 to #6aa8ff 2.4), the fill bluer (#4a5fc0 to #3a6ae0) and the grade's Moon step at chroma 0.45 (rig_night): shade h 314 to 261, cold 28% to 52%, key 2.18, pool 0.42, Lp50 0.27; the stage's camp fire pool (18 m) holds the rest of the chroma. C2 (the Stage B judge on the frames: 09 Lp50 0.13 and 12 0.07, midC 0.05-0.07, black leaf stencils, 05 warm 7%; rules 1, 4, 9): the moon's floor and its chroma from the light, not the surfaces: the key bluer (#5a9cff) and its cast shadow 0.8 to 0.6, the fill bluer (#2c5cf4) at 0.12 to 0.4, the sky #2c4c8c at hemi 1.6 to 2.4; the dapple's dark clamped to the moon-shade band (strength 1.0 to 0.55: under the leaves 45% of the moon, two blues); her ember the pool (3.5 to 8.0, its reach x1.5, #ff8a3a) at exposure 1.3 to 1.15. 05: Lp50 0.20 to 0.21, Lp95 0.38 to 0.45, key 1.96 to 2.17, pool 0.31 to 0.35, midC 0.046 to 0.070, warm 7% to 18% (target 05: 0.20, 0.43, 2.17, 0.35, 0.119, 20%).

night_town.from: LB_light NIGHT (the square): the same moon and sky as the wild's night; inside walls the lamps and windows carry the warm (rule 3), the moon a cold wash from the town's south-east (the square's shadows as the town's buildings stand). Start: NightTown (E9d r2, Rendering r1-r2).

night_wild.from: the night rig on the generic wild's night (the Verge by night, the cinematics' 'night'): its moon high in the south-east as the preset has it, the night rig's fill, rim, ink and dapple. Start: Night.

arena_night.from: LB_light ARENA and target 09: the night rig's fill, rim, ink, hardness and dapple on every arena; each place keeps its own moon, sky and exposure (ArenaPlaces: the barrow's open sky, the Hollow's low broken moon), so one rig and one pack preset (rule 7) under four moons. C2 (09 Lp50 0.13, 12 0.07; rules 1, 4): the moon's hue, its cast shadow, the sky's color and the floor (hemi 2.2) and the grade (rig_night: the moon step's chroma) are the rig's now; each place keeps its moon's way and strength, its ground and exposure. 09: Lp50 0.11 to 0.25, midC 0.064 to 0.089, cold 73% to 86%; 12 (her lamp out): 0.07 to 0.17, midC 0.059 to 0.089 (targets 0.24, 0.118/0.094).

day_town.from: LB_light DAY and target 07 (its shade share, violet-blue shade and ink; not its key): a pale-gold sun (#f3d9a0, rule 3) where the game's stands (r0 07: her shadow falls down-left, rule 5), the blue sky's violet-blue fill coloring the shade band (rule 2: h 240-310; on her skin mauve, MB1 h about 325); key 1.6+, Lp50 0.40-0.60 (rule 1). Start: WaystationDay (G1 r2). B4r2: fires 0.2 (rule 3, one warm light a scene: by day the sun; the lookdev stage's camp fire at its night strength, 6.7 m off, was the warm half of her shade at the close view, h 4 to 322 with it at 0.2). Key, sky and grade as they were: the stage's play-day key (p95/p50) held at 1.15-1.23 across sun 6.6-10, sky 0.35-0.7 and contrast 1.3-1.6 (lit ground is its median), so it is checked on 07 in Stage C. B3r3 (tools/look/joint.py): the fill solved with every class's albedo over the boards' lit and shade samples (MB2-MB4, 07's shade): #6a5ce0 0.12 to #7789ff 0.1063 (the shade sides at the boards' share of the lit). C2 (the Stage B judge: 07 key 1.21, Lp95 0.57; rule 1 day key 1.6+, about Lp95 0.70; the sun where the game's stands, rule 5): the sun 6.6 to 11, the sky's floor down (hemi 0.7 to 0.4, env 0.55 to 0.3) and the violet fill up (0.1063 to 0.14) so the shade keeps its share, and the grade's contrast x1.6 ('name@K', Atmospheres.GradeNamed: by day the key held at 1.19 across sun 6.6-11, the grade's curve, not the light). 07: Lp95 0.62 to 0.72, key 1.22 to 1.30, midC 0.065 to 0.090; 13: Lp95 0.68 to 0.77 (targets 07 0.71/1.37, 13 0.76/1.62). The rest of the key is the surfaces' (the lit setts are the median: C1).

day_wild.from: the day rig in the wild (the Verge, 04): the same pale-gold sun and violet-blue sky, the sun where the Verge's stands (its north-east, as the preset has it). Start: Day. C2 (04 key 1.46, shade h 146; rules 1, 2): the sun 3.8 to 6.5, the sky's floor down (hemi 1.0 to 0.55, env 0.85 to 0.45), the violet fill 0.1063 to 0.24 into the shade, the grade's contrast x1.6. 04: Lp95 0.60 to 0.69, key 1.30 to 1.38, midC 0.060 to 0.093 (target 0.66/1.55); its shade stays green (h 141): under the foliage the shade is the leaves' own green albedo (C3a's kit), not the light.

dawn.from: LB_light DAWN: a low warm sun (pale gold toward peach, rule 3) from the Low Ford's east, long shadows, the shade lilac (rule 2); the dawn's frost and thaw stay the preset's air. Start: LowFordDawn (G1 r2-r3). B4r3, from LB_light DAWN (measured: Lp50 0.44, key 1.76, shC 0.046, shH 333, midC 0.079, warm 55%, cold 5%): the key 10 to 14, the fill bluer-lilac and up (#8a6ad0 0.10 to #9a64d2 0.18: shC 0.034 to 0.042, the lilac shade held at h 335), the grade's contrast 1.14 to 1.4 (rig_dawn: key 1.55 to 1.6; the panel's sunrise sky, out of the play camera's view, holds the rest), fires 0.5 (rule 3: the low sun is the warm light; the stage's camp fire at night strength took warm to 76% of chroma, the panel's 55).

dawn_morning.from: the dawn rig an hour on (Atmospheres.Morning's end): the sun higher and paler. Start: LowFordMorning. B4r3: the dawn rig's key 14 at its old share (6.6 of 10: 9.5), the fill a step bluer (#9068d6; the higher sun warms the shade: h 354 to 332, LB DAWN 333), fires 0.3 (toward the day's 0.2).

dawn_waystation.from: the dawn rig over the Waystation: the sun low in the town's north-east, as the town's buildings stand. Start: WaystationDawn.

close_night.from: rule 11 and MB1 NIGHT: one key from the front three-quarter (35 round, 40 up), so her face and front carry the band (B4r2: at 1.4 of the world key, 1.0 left her band 0.21 L over her shade; rule 11's 0.25+); moon-cold, warmed toward her ember's or a near fire's color (the scene's source); the night rig's colored fill in her shade (rule 2: night h 220-290) and its stepped moon rim on her lit edge (rule 7). One key, one fill, one rim (rule 3).

close_day.from: rule 11 and MB1 DAY: one pale-gold key (#f3d9a0) from the front three-quarter (35, 40); the day rig's violet-blue fill turns her skin's shade mauve (MB1 h about 325, rule 2) by its color alone; the pale-gold rim on her lit edge.

look.from: rule 11 at the Look camera (the title's camp at night): her key from the front three-quarter (35, 40) in the camp fire's warmth, the night rig's indigo fill in her shade and its moon rim; KA and 08 follow MB1's face.

look_day.from: rule 11 at the Look by day (--look-time day) and MB1 (the face board, the Look camera's law): the close-up's day key (#f3d9a0, 35, 40) and a fill of its own, so her skin's shade band reads MB1's mauve (h about 325). B4r3: the day rig's fill (#6a5ce0, h 283, at 0.12) left her shade h 275 here (the close view h 322): the Look's day is the open-sky Day (the Verge's air, not the town's) and its camp fire is culled off her at the portrait (GameFront: the stand-in fades to 0), so no warm source reaches her shade and the sky's cold light is most of it (her shade L 0.46 to the lit 0.71); by toggles the grade (waystation_day), the sky share (hemi 0.7, env 0.55, ground #605245) and the sky reflections each moved that hue under 1 degree; only the fill's own hue moves it. A magenta-mauve fill (#c848b8, h 333) at 0.08, and the key at 1.15 so the band holds 0.25 L over the cold sky light: shade h 315, C 0.034, dL 0.262 (at 0.12-0.18 the fill reached the hue but lifted the shade to dL 0.20-0.23).
